title: Identity lifecycle and quarterly attestation automation for Private deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a cohesive identity lifecycle and attestation pipeline for Redwood Private customers: delegated SCIM provisioning from IdPs, hardened SAML session settings with short-lived assertions, RBAC role reconciliation hooks, and an automated quarterly access attestation + evidence bundle exporter for auditors.
background: Customers in regulated industries require proof that access to sensitive resources is provisioned correctly, reviewed periodically, and that evidence (audit logs, attestations, deprovisioning records) is exportable. Existing work covers generic SSO/SCIM onboarding and privileged access attestation separately; this ticket unites provisioning, runtime access controls, and evidence automation into a repeatable workflow for Private/VPC deployments.
decision_notes: We will use delegated SCIM where supported by the IdP (Google Workspace, Okta, Azure AD) and implement a fallback Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning path. RBAC will be centralized in the control plane with a reconciliation job that emits audit events to the evidence pipeline. Quarterly attestation will be driven by an orchestration job that snapshots access lists, sends review tasks to owners, and bundles signed attestations + supporting logs into a time-stamped export. Encryption of exported bundles will use customer KMS when available.
acceptance_criteria: SCIM provisioning: Users and groups created/updated via SCIM in staging with upsert semantics and membership syncing
SAML hardening: Session length configurable per-organization, default 1 hour; test IdP assertion expiration and reauth flows
RBAC reconciliation: Daily job that compares live assignments to control plane desired state and emits discrepancy alerts
Attestation workflow: Quarterly job creates review tasks, tracks reviewer responses, escalates to owners after 7 days, and marks attestation complete
Evidence export: Single archive (encrypted) containing attestation statements, access snapshots, SCIM logs, SAML session events, and reconciliation audit trail
Automated tests: E2E tests exercising SCIM upsert, JIT path, reconciliation diff, and attestation export with sample KMS key
Docs and runbook: Console UI flow documented and runbook for support to investigate failed attestations
tasks: Design API endpoints for SCIM delegated provisioning and JIT fallback
Implement SCIM client with idempotent upsert and group membership sync
Add SAML session configuration per org and enforce assertion lifetime
Centralize RBAC assignments and build reconciliation lambda + scheduler
Build attestation orchestrator that creates reviewer tasks and collects signed responses
Integrate evidence bundler with KMS encryption and upload to customer-configured storage or Redwood secure bucket
Add telemetry: metrics for provisioning failures, reconciliation drift, attestation completion rate
Create E2E test harness and run against staging IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, Google)
Console: Add UI for initiating ad-hoc attestations and viewing last attestation artifacts
Run security review and threat model workshop; remediate findings
risks_mitigation: Risk: SCIM schema drift across IdPs. Mitigation: canonical mapping layer + per-IdP transforms and strict validation logs
Risk: Attestor fatigue causing missed reviews. Mitigation: email + Slack reminders, 7-day escalation, owner delegation
Risk: Export contains sensitive PII. Mitigation: export redaction policy and KMS-based encryption per-customer
Risk: Reconciliation job heavy on DB. Mitigation: incremental diffs and sampling + backoff under high load
